skill.summary: Interact with Bitget Wallet API for crypto market data, token info, swap quotes, and security audits. Use when the user asks about token prices, market data,...

latestVersion.changelog:
Bitget Wallet Skill initial release.

- Provides API integration for Bitget Wallet: get crypto market data, token info, swap quotes, and security audits.
- Supports major chains: ETH, SOL, BSC, Base, and more.
- Includes instructions for version checking and upgrades, with security review after update.
- Guides first-time swap configuration (deadline, security checks, preferences).
- Handles all amounts in human-readable form (not smallest chain units).
- Documents correct swap and security audit flow and interpretation.
- Details valid parameters for K-line and transaction info commands.
